name: text-3d-flip
title: Text 3D Flip
description: Letters that flip in 3D, one after another, when hovered.

props.name: children
props.description: The text to flip (text is read out of nested elements too).

props.name: textClassName
props.description: Classes for each letter's front face (visible before the flip).

props.name: flipTextClassName
props.description: Classes for each letter's back face (revealed by the flip).

props.name: staggerDuration
props.description: Seconds between each letter starting its flip.
